newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam says nothing new in report.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam says nothing new in report.

text.p: A Sunbeam Corp spokesman confirmed its chairman had said the company was beginning to talk with investment bankers about a range of options for the firm, noting the statement was nothing beyond what the firm had communicated to Wall Street previously.
"It isn't anything different from what we've told Wall Street the ultimate strategy was," he said.

The spokesman said Sunbeam had completed its restructuring under Chairman Albert Dunlap and it was now delivering the results to investors. During the second half of the year, the company wanted to be prepared for a wide range of options that could possibly include a sale of the firm or making a large acquisition.
A report in Monday's Wall Street Journal said Dunlap was exploring options, including a possible sale of the firm or making a large acquisition.
Sunbeam's stock was up 1/2 to 33-3/8 on 662,400-share volume in late-afternoon trading.
